topic: Career angle: Goldman says AI could displace 1 in 11 US workers. Use the waiting period wisely.
post:
Goldman Sachs says AI could displace about 1 in 11 US workers. 📊
But the timing is the part that should shape your career plan.

What the analysts are saying 👇
🔢 Goldman projects AI could displace about 9% of US workers over a decade-long adoption cycle
⏳ It expects companies to hold off on big cuts until a recession
📉 Pantheon Macroeconomics estimates AI is already eliminating more than 10,000 US roles a month, mostly in accounting, advertising, office admin and legal work

These are estimates, not certainties. But they point the same way: the change is gradual now, and could speed up when the economy turns.

Why it matters:
If the big cuts wait for a downturn, the next year or two is your runway. That's the window to make yourself the person who uses AI well, not the task AI replaces.

Practical takeaway:
List the 3 tasks you do most each week. For each one, ask: can AI do this? If yes, learn to run it with AI and move toward the judgment work around it. 🧭

Is your field already feeling it? 👇

Follow for daily AI news you can actually use.
